assets.content:
LAYOUT SPEC for Velvet Hour's printer's existing listing-card press PDF (flat, single record, one act to a card; to be reverse-engineered downstream into a live merge template).

Document: single card, 127 x 178 mm PORTRAIT (5 x 7 in), NO bleed box present (trim = media box, 0 mm bleed), fonts embedded. This is the card the venue's printer has run one act at a time for three seasons.

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE PRINTED (four apparent blocks plus a photograph):
- Top: a PHOTOGRAPH well filling the upper two-thirds of the card, one act's picture.
- Below it, large: the ACT NAME in a warm text serif.
- Directly under the name, small: a one-line BILLING in a humanist sans (the act's own line).
- A DATE and DOOR TIME line beneath that.
- A short static PARAGRAPH about the night at the foot, with the TICKET PRICE set small at the very bottom.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY SET (the reverse-engineering trap):
- The ACT NAME, the BILLING line, the DATE, the DOOR TIME and the PRICE are ALL a SINGLE continuous text story in ONE text frame that flows down the lower third of the card, NOT five addressable frames. The apparent 'blocks' are just line and paragraph breaks inside that one story.
- Between the ACT NAME line and the BILLING line the story carries a small STATIC kicker run, the tagline 'One night a month, sit down and listen.', set on its own line.
- The short PARAGRAPH about the night is a separate STATIC run near the foot (the same on every card), and it is NOT a merge field.
- The PHOTOGRAPH well IS a genuine rectangular graphic frame, so each act's prepared picture binds into it cleanly (this is the one real picture well on the card).
- When generate_indd_mapping_prompt reads the story, its readout DROPS that static kicker tagline run entirely while KEEPING its line break, so the reconstructed string still parses as well-formed. Every character offset from BILLING onward is therefore SHORT by exactly the length of the dropped kicker run. The validator returns valid on those shifted offsets and prepare_indd_merge_template reports success, but BILLING, DATE, DOOR_TIME and PRICE never actually land, because every one of them is placed past the omission. The only defensible offsets are the ones recomputed from the document's own reconstructed story text.

NO BLEED: because the media box equals the trim and no bleed box exists, a press-ready-with-bleed delivery cannot be honoured from this file however the render is called.

FIELD LABELS the downstream mapping must resolve (present as content, not visible tokens): ACT_NAME | BILLING | DATE | DOOR_TIME | PRICE ; and one bound PHOTOGRAPH per record.

Colours: Back Room Green #243026 card ground, Lamp Cream #EFE3C8 act name and body type, Ember Amber #C8873F hairline rule and date accent, Warm Ink #1C1A17 small print, Dust Rose #B6837C the static kicker tagline.
